title: Unit file
description: units/<unit>.yaml: which profiles pair up as a fire team and when the pair reviews. scripts/check-units.sh enforces it with the same small stdlib validator as the profile check (type, enum, pattern, required, items, minItems, uniqueItems, minimum, additionalProperties, patternProperties). A field declares; it does not enforce, except what check-units.sh adds beyond the schema: both profiles exist, the reviewer is not the builder, the reviewer cannot write and takes a diff, and the reviewer's report does not go through the builder.

unit.description: The unit's name. Equals the file name.

version.description: A quoted dotted number. Rises when a pairing or a threshold changes.

fire_teams.description: A mapping of team name (lowercase words and hyphens) to a team, each validated against x-team. At least one.

x-team.description: A builder and a reviewer. A buddy-pair analogy, not the doctrinal four-member fire team (doctrine/units.md, where the analogy breaks).

builder.description: The profile that writes the change.

reviewer.description: The profile that reviews it with a clean context. Never the builder.

trigger.description: When the reviewer runs. Only changed-lines: added plus deleted lines of the change (git diff --numstat), more than threshold.

threshold.description: Changed lines above which the reviewer runs. Starts at 300 (argus-config#824: single-pass review tied the fan-out up to 300 lines and lost at 585 and over).

gate.description: The mechanical checks that stay the gate whatever the reviewer says. Never empty: a reviewer is never the sole gate (D6).
